fixes: The Header on line 0 (level 1, id "ledger") is the section title that governs every block after it (the paragraph on lines 1-13, the table on lines 14-59, the list on lines 60-61). No table records this. In parse(), keep track of the most recent Header while walking elems in document order. Add a `section` column holding that header's id (or its text when the id is empty) to every row of paragraphs, list_items, other_blocks and each table_N. Without it, a later capture with several headers produces paragraphs and list items that cannot be tied to their section.

list_items (from lines 60-61) identifies a row only by list type and item number. A second BulletList anywhere in a document would produce another row reading `BulletList 1 ...`, and the two could not be told apart. Add a `list` ordinal column (1 for the list starting on line 60, 2 for the next, and so on) and keep `type` as BulletList or OrderedList.
